package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"time"
)

const (
	PlanningRequestSchemaV1               = "tz-planning-request.v1"
	PlanningRequestSchemaV2               = "tz-planning-request.v2"
	PlanningRequestSchemaV3               = "tz-planning-request.v3"
	SourceAuthoringRequestSchemaV1        = "tz-source-authoring-request.v1"
	AuthoringOrchestrationIntentSchemaV1  = "learning-workspace-authoring-intent.v1"
	AuthoringTriggerPlannerRecommendation = "planner_recommendation"
	AuthoringTriggerStudentProject        = "student_project"
	SurfaceClassificationPractice         = "practice"
	SurfaceClassificationProject          = "project"
	VerificationReceiptSchemaV1           = "validation-contract-verification-receipt.v1"
)

type JobStatus string

const (
	JobStatusPlanned    JobStatus = "PLANNED"
	JobStatusGenerating JobStatus = "GENERATING"
	JobStatusVerifying  JobStatus = "VERIFYING"
	JobStatusReady      JobStatus = "READY"
	JobStatusStaged     JobStatus = "STAGED"
	JobStatusFailed     JobStatus = "FAILED"
)

type PlanningRequestV1 struct {
	Schema               string                          `json:"schema"`
	Mode                 string                          `json:"mode"`
	Manifest             string                          `json:"manifest"`
	PreparedSourceTask   *PreparedSourceTaskV1           `json:"prepared_source_task,omitempty"`
	Locale               string                          `json:"locale"`
	Source               PlanningSource                  `json:"source"`
	Hints                ClassificationHint              `json:"classification_hints"`
	Orchestration        *AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1 `json:"orchestration,omitempty"`
	orchestrationPresent bool
}

type PreparedSourceTaskV1 struct {
	SchemaVersion string                    `json:"schema_version"`
	Source        PreparedSourceReferenceV1 `json:"source"`
	Title         string                    `json:"title"`
	Content       string                    `json:"content"`
	Metadata      map[string]any            `json:"metadata"`
	ContentHash   string                    `json:"content_hash"`
}

type PreparedSourceReferenceV1 struct {
	Provider      string `json:"provider"`
	RepositoryURL string `json:"repository_url"`
	CommitSHA     string `json:"commit_sha"`
	Path          string `json:"path"`
	Locator       string `json:"locator,omitempty"`
}

type SourceAuthoringRequestV1 struct {
	Schema             string               `json:"schema"`
	PreparedSourceTask PreparedSourceTaskV1 `json:"prepared_source_task"`
}

type AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1 struct {
	Schema                   string `json:"schema"`
	Trigger                  string `json:"trigger"`
	CorrelationID            string `json:"correlation_id"`
	SurfaceClassification    string `json:"surface_classification"`
	DesiredDifficultyLevel   string `json:"desired_difficulty_level,omitempty"`
	desiredDifficultyPresent bool
}

func (request PlanningRequestV1) TrustedSurfaceClassification() string {
	if request.Schema == PlanningRequestSchemaV2 && request.Orchestration != nil {
		return request.Orchestration.SurfaceClassification
	}
	return SurfaceClassificationPractice
}

func (request PlanningRequestV1) DesiredDifficultyLevel() string {
	if request.Schema == PlanningRequestSchemaV2 && request.Orchestration != nil {
		return request.Orchestration.DesiredDifficultyLevel
	}
	return ""
}

func (request PlanningRequestV1) HasOrchestrationIntent() bool {
	return request.orchestrationPresent || request.Orchestration != nil
}

func (request *PlanningRequestV1) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	type requestShape PlanningRequestV1
	var decoded requestShape
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&decoded); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("planning request contains trailing JSON")
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, orchestrationPresent := fields["orchestration"]
	*request = PlanningRequestV1(decoded)
	request.orchestrationPresent = orchestrationPresent
	return nil
}

func (intent AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1) HasDesiredDifficultyLevel() bool {
	return intent.desiredDifficultyPresent || intent.DesiredDifficultyLevel != ""
}

func (intent *AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	type intentShape AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1
	var decoded intentShape
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&decoded); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("orchestration intent contains trailing JSON")
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, desiredDifficultyPresent := fields["desired_difficulty_level"]
	*intent = AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1(decoded)
	intent.desiredDifficultyPresent = desiredDifficultyPresent
	return nil
}

type PlanningSource struct {
	Type       string `json:"type"`
	URL        string `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Company    string `json:"company,omitempty"`
	License    string `json:"license,omitempty"`
	Anonymized bool   `json:"anonymized"`
}

type ClassificationHint struct {
	TaskType string   `json:"task_type,omitempty"`
	Stacks   []string `json:"stacks,omitempty"`
}

type GenerationPolicy struct {
	PlannerVersion          string
	GenerationPolicyVersion string
	TechnicalTaskSchema     string
	PromptTemplateRef       string
	Tone                    string
	Methodology             string
	SkillRefs               []string
}

type PlanningJob struct {
	ID                       string
	IdempotencyKey           string
	RequestHash              string
	Request                  PlanningRequestV1
	Status                   JobStatus
	Attempts                 int
	LeaseToken               string
	LeaseExpiresAt           *time.Time
	Artifact                 *AuthoringArtifact
	Staging                  *StagingReceiptV1
	LegacyPublicationPresent bool
	FailureCode              string
	CreatedAt                time.Time
	UpdatedAt                time.Time
}

type StagingReceiptV1 struct {
	Schema          string    `json:"schema"`
	StagedID        string    `json:"staged_id"`
	AuthoringJobID  string    `json:"authoring_job_id"`
	State           string    `json:"state"`
	Created         bool      `json:"created"`
	FamilyKey       string    `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey      string    `json:"variant_key"`
	CandidateDigest string    `json:"candidate_digest"`
	BlueprintDigest string    `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

type AuthoringArtifact struct {
	Candidate          AuthoringCandidateV1
	CandidateDigest    string
	CapabilitiesDigest string
	ContractDigest     string
	Verification       VerificationReceiptV1
}

type RuntimeProfileDescriptor struct {
	Ref                         RuntimeProfileRef `json:"ref"`
	SupportedCodeStructureTypes []string          `json:"supported_code_structure_types"`
	NetworkPolicy               string            `json:"network_policy"`
}

type ContractInspection struct {
	Schema             string   `json:"schema"`
	ContractKind       string   `json:"contract_kind"`
	ContractVersion    int      `json:"contract_version"`
	ContractDigest     string   `json:"contract_digest"`
	CapabilitiesDigest string   `json:"capabilities_digest"`
	ExecutionOrder     []string `json:"execution_order"`
	RequiredEngines    []string `json:"required_engines"`
	MissingEngines     []string `json:"missing_engines"`
	Runnable           bool     `json:"runnable"`
}

type VerificationCase struct {
	ID            string `json:"id"`
	Kind          string `json:"kind"`
	WorkspaceRoot string `json:"workspace_root"`
}

type VerificationRequestV1 struct {
	Schema               string             `json:"schema"`
	BlueprintDigest      string             `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	RuntimeProfileDigest string             `json:"runtime_profile_digest"`
	CodeStructure        json.RawMessage    `json:"code_structure"`
	Cases                []VerificationCase `json:"cases"`
}

type VerificationReceiptV1 struct {
	Schema               string                   `json:"schema"`
	BlueprintDigest      string                   `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	RuntimeProfileDigest string                   `json:"runtime_profile_digest"`
	ContractDigest       string                   `json:"contract_digest"`
	CapabilitiesDigest   string                   `json:"capabilities_digest"`
	Passed               bool                     `json:"passed"`
	Cases                []VerificationCaseResult `json:"cases"`
	VerifiedAt           time.Time                `json:"verified_at"`
	ReceiptDigest        string                   `json:"receipt_digest"`
}

type VerificationCaseResult struct {
	ID             string `json:"id"`
	Kind           string `json:"kind"`
	ExpectedPassed bool   `json:"expected_passed"`
	ActualPassed   bool   `json:"actual_passed"`
	ResultDigest   string `json:"result_digest"`
}

type VerificationWorkspace struct {
	ID       string
	RootPath string
}

type GenerationInput struct {
	JobID           string
	Request         PlanningRequestV1
	ManifestDigest  string
	Policy          GenerationPolicy
	RuntimeProfiles []RuntimeProfileDescriptor
	LearningTargets []LearningTargetDescriptor
}

type LearningTargetDescriptor struct {
	Ref           LearningTargetRef   `json:"ref"`
	Title         string              `json:"title"`
	Description   string              `json:"description"`
	Prerequisites []LearningTargetRef `json:"prerequisites"`
}

type JobRepository interface {
	Ensure(ctx context.Context, job PlanningJob) (stored PlanningJob, created bool, err error)
	Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (PlanningJob, error)
	Claim(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) (PlanningJob, error)
	RenewLease(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) error
	MarkVerifying(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time) error
	SaveReady(ctx context.Context, id, token string, artifact AuthoringArtifact, now time.Time) error
	SaveStaging(ctx context.Context, id string, staging StagingReceiptV1, now time.Time) error
	SaveFailed(ctx context.Context, id, token, failureCode string, now time.Time) error
}

type CandidateGenerator interface {
	Generate(ctx context.Context, input GenerationInput) (AuthoringCandidateV1, error)
}

type CompetencyResolver interface {
	DiscoverTargets(ctx context.Context, stacks []string) ([]LearningTargetDescriptor, error)
	ResolveExactTargets(ctx context.Context, targets []LearningTargetRef) error
}

type RuntimeProfileCatalog interface {
	ListRuntimeProfiles(ctx context.Context) ([]RuntimeProfileDescriptor, error)
}

type ValidationAuthoringClient interface {
	InspectContract(ctx context.Context, codeStructure json.RawMessage) (ContractInspection, error)
	VerifyContract(ctx context.Context, request VerificationRequestV1) (VerificationReceiptV1, error)
}

type VerificationWorkspaceClient interface {
	CreateVerificationWorkspace(ctx context.Context, profile RuntimeProfileRef, fixture WorkspaceFixture, ttl time.Duration) (VerificationWorkspace, error)
	DeleteVerificationWorkspace(ctx context.Context, id string) error
}

type PracticeStager interface {
	Stage(ctx context.Context, jobID string, artifact AuthoringArtifact) (StagingReceiptV1, error)
}
